name: Kajiwara Yuriko
source:
A married woman who was sent for false charges (murder). Her sentence is 8 years with no probation.

Prisoner number 674.

Her husband is Masaomi Kajiwara.

He is an ordinary company employee, and there is nothing special about him. She has been married for 8 years and has no children, but she would like to have some. She is not dissatisfied with her life and strongly loves her husband.

While driving a car, she causes an accident that kills the other driver. The dead man was the son of a famous deputy, and the fault lies with the other party, but there were no witnesses, the other party was also a powerful man, so she is sent to a prison camp for gross negligence.

Her husband is not satisfied with the verdict, but the deputies have been working around the clock and all appeals have been dismissed. While trying to do something about it, Yuriko is sent to an internment camp. Yuriko believes that one day the truth will come out and she will be able to get out of prison.

She is a chaste woman and is very reluctant to be raped by a man other than her husband. She is not violent, but resists the protagonist with great effort.
